title: Read by an agent
sub: Film 3 of Quality as a habit, the second series of the module Data quality: an agent reads only what's written down. An empty date meant two things, the column's description didn't say so, and the agent answered 412 with confidence. A column's description is part of the data, so its quality is the data's quality.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look, the quality bench: a limestone wall, a granite bench, records on cream cards. Green passes, amber holds for a person, red stops and grey wasn't checked; brass is what good means, and steel blue a measure. The agent is a ceramic sphere with a violet band, and only its words are violet. The opening is an office of about 2000.
